gates.acceptance: Retain exact source/tree, current browser report, CI and cleanup evidence.

gates.name: Course and assignment acceptance
gates.acceptance: Select course, assignment/template revision, datasets, rubric, tutoring policy, submission files and intended participants. Run that actual package through the notebook-to-receipt flow and preserve wrong-answer/refusal controls.
gates.next_action: Course selection question is pending; inventory existing INFO511 packages without activating their historical source-only bindings.

gates.name: Real sign-in and current course admission
gates.owner: Waypoint runtime chat; identity administrator to be named
gates.acceptance: On selected host and real identity provider, verify canonical issuer/subject, current roster grants, learner/instructor separation, cross-course denial, revocation, expired sessions and restart. Storage creation must never grant admission.
gates.next_action: Identify existing approved host/identity provider, then prepare private configuration references and exact acceptance cases.

gates.name: Student data and inference route
gates.owner: Greg for data-flow decision; classroom coordination for component contract
gates.acceptance: Approved destinations for submissions, membership, tutor payloads, logs, usage ledger, exports and backups; exact active endpoint/model/profile; no forbidden fallback. Account for actual transport attempts including SDK/proxy retries, failed calls and unknown liabilities.
gates.next_action: Current OpenRouter adapter accepts only fixed synthetic content. Student registry contains placeholder model names/unverified metadata and retries; it is not an accepted live deployment. Qualify an approved course-bound route before student tutoring.

gates.name: Instructional quality and no-AI fallback
gates.acceptance: Review real tutor outputs for the selected task against a fixed case set; preserve bad/uncertain results; demonstrate that tutoring never submits or grades and refusal/outage retains work and permits non-AI completion.
gates.next_action: Prepare review cases now; defer actual model execution until endpoint, allowed inputs and finite budget are pinned.

gates.name: Notebook/R runtime reliability
gates.acceptance: Locate failure layer, correct actionable defects, verify Python/R execution, save/restart, refusal and cleanup on exact candidate. Record recurrence, failure denominator and limitations. Prior passes do not establish historical cause.
gates.next_action: Integrate the reviewed secure-WebSocket probe patch through normal review/CI; prepare windowed diagnostics and role-specific host inventory. Qualify the selected R/editor candidate and Python/R save/restart on the actual hosted topology. No blind full-runtime rerun.
